title: The gate page's domain
what: What the console's gate page calls a gate and a Laya mode, from the host's language pack or the gate's own name.

title: The gate trial page
what: The gate trial page at /gates/<stage>: a prompt put to one gate as a turn would, the gate's trials oldest first, and its Laya mode and agreement.

title: The console's server routes
what: The console bundle's server routes: a trial put, a gate's trials read and Laya's view read, through the generated client and the host's sign-in.
